South Korea finished third, having won one game, while the Czech Republic finished fourth with a single point.
South Korea vs Czech Republic
Pre-match ceremony between South Korea and Czech Republic
South Korea and Czechoslovakia, the Czech Republic's predecessor state, met previously three times in the 1980s, with a win for the Koreans and two draws.
